root_cause_analysis: The automated visual quality assurance stage failed to pass validation for the rendered carousel. Specifically, Slide 1 failed with an overall score of 0 due to an upstream service or renderer timeout ('Visual audit unavailable'), dragging the slide set average score down to 4.8 and breaching the minimum acceptance threshold. The orchestrator threw an unhandled ValueError at engine.py:183, terminating the evening edition pipeline run.
actionable_instructions: Verify the network reachability, API quota, and health of the visual inspection/vision LLM service responsible for auditing rendered slides.
Inspect the intermediate rendered slide images for Slide 1 under the build artifacts to verify if rendering crashed or generated an unreadable/corrupt image file.
Implement a retry strategy with exponential backoff around the visual audit module in engine.py:183 to prevent transient evaluation timeouts from raising a hard failure.
Manually rerun the pipeline for the 'evening' edition using '--dry-run' or force bypass flags if visual audit service is experiencing prolonged downtime.
